what: Allowance-side against transfer-side scores on GMX V2 contract traders, an outcome built from neither edge type: every contrast of the grid, the stratified contrasts, single-score coefficients, the recipient comparison, the influence check and the verdicts of R1-R3, for the revised and the registered analysis in W1 (primary) and W0 (secondary). Copied from the evaluation summaries of phd_works; nothing is computed here except recompute_check.

recompute_check.method: Independent implementation in this script: tau_b from pair counts, index matrix numpy.random.default_rng(42).integers(0, n, size=(2000, n)) over the score frame sorted by contract id, percentile intervals (numpy.percentile, linear). W0 frames are the holdout trader score files, whose t1 degree columns are the freeze-date degrees of W0. Tolerance 1e-9 for coefficients and interval ends, 1/B for share_positive, exact for counts.
